companyIntro.name: Tradewind Supply Partners
companyIntro.mission: Source the right goods at the right total cost, fairly and on time.
companyIntro.culture: Fair process, documented decisions. If you cannot justify an award in writing, you cannot make it.

projectBackground.name: Materials Sourcing Programme — Transformer Package
projectBackground.context: A transformer is on the project's critical path. Bidders differ on price, delivery and compliance.

manager.name: Selin Demir
manager.role: Head of Procurement, Tradewind Supply Partners
manager.note: Technical compliance first, then price. A non-compliant cheap item is the most expensive one you can buy.

assignment.title: Place the order without risking the schedule
assignment.brief: Compute landed cost and delivery float, evaluate technical compliance, set PO terms and write an expediting email.

documents.name: Quotation
documents.note: Ex-works price €50,000; freight €2,500; import duty 5% of price; insurance 0.5%.

documents.name: Lead Time Data
documents.note: Manufacture 14 weeks; transit 3 weeks; inspection 1 week; required on site in 20 weeks.

documents.name: Technical Datasheet
documents.note: Bidder's rating below the specified short-circuit level.

tasks.title: Landed Cost
tasks.prompt: Price €50,000, freight €2,500, duty 5% of price (€2,500), insurance 0.5% (€250). What is the landed cost (€)?
tasks.reasoning: Landed cost includes everything to site.
tasks.mistake: Comparing ex-works prices hides €5,250 of cost.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Delivery Float
tasks.prompt: Manufacture 14 weeks + transit 3 + inspection 1 = 18 weeks. Required on site in 20 weeks. What is the float (weeks)?
tasks.tip: Order immediately when float is thin.
tasks.mistake: Delaying PO by 3 weeks makes the item late.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Technical Evaluation
tasks.prompt: A bidder's rating is below the specified short-circuit level. What should you do?
options: Treat as non-compliant until clarified or corrected
tasks.mistake: Accepting non-compliant equipment creates a safety risk.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Inspection
tasks.prompt: What does an Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) provide?
options: Agreed inspection and witness points before shipment
tasks.mistake: Skipping ITPs finds defects on site.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: PO Terms
tasks.prompt: Select terms a good purchase order includes.
tasks.reasoning: Clear terms protect cost and schedule.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Expediting Email
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence expediting email to the supplier.
tasks.modelAnswer: Dear Mr Weber, our transformer order is on the project's critical path with only two weeks of float. Please confirm by Friday the current manufacturing status, the planned test date and the shipping booking. If any milestone has slipped, tell us the new date and what we can do to help. We would like to schedule an inspection visit in week 12.
tasks.reasoning: A good expediting email is specific, dated and offers help.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Late Transformer
caseStudy.background: A transformer was ordered with no delay damages or inspection plan. It arrived 10 weeks late and failed factory tests on site, delaying energisation by 5 months.
caseStudy.challenges: No schedule float analysis or quality plan.
questions: How should you track critical items?
caseStudy.solution: Tradewind added critical item tracking, ITPs and delay damages to every PO.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Protect schedule and quality before the PO.
